title: Healthy Boundaries for Healthy Relationships
intro: Healthy relationships don't all look the same, but they share a similar foundation. Whether casual or committed, traditional or non-traditional, a healthy relationship starts with open, honest communication. Respect and empathy are also key.

sections.heading: Relationship Green Flags
sections.markdown:
* Mutual respect and trust
* Open and honest communication
* Active boundary setting
* Emotional intelligence and empathy
* Accountability and responsibility

By focusing on building healthy relationships, you can create a safer and more respectful environment for everyone. Prioritize boundary setting. Practice active listening and empathy. Respect one another's autonomy and decisions.

Encourage open and honest communication. Hold one another accountable for living out these relationship green flags.

Sexual assault prevention is the responsibility of every Marine. For resources and support, visit: [www.usmc-mccs.org/sapr](http://www.usmc-mccs.org/sapr).
